title: Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations by Correcting Modality Misrouting in Omnimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.18141v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omnimodal large language models (OLLMs) are susceptible to cross-modal hallucinations under audio-visual interference. We find that, for a substantial fraction of incorrect joint predictions, the question-relevant unimodal branch can still recover the correct answer, suggesting that task-relevant evidence can remain recoverable from the relevant modality even when it is not reflected in the joint prediction. We refer to this recoverable failure pattern as \emph{modality misrouting}. We propose CaRe (Conflict-aware Residual Intervention), a training-free inference-time method for identifying and correcting modality misrouting. CaRe uses a text-only modality probe to identify a candidate modality-specific counterfactual branch, and flags potential misrouting when its prediction conflicts with the original joint prediction. translated_title: 通过纠正全模态大语言模型中的模态误路由来缓解跨模态幻觉
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型（OLLMs）在音视频干扰下容易产生跨模态幻觉。我们发现，在相当一部分错误的联合预测中，与问题相关的单模态分支仍然可以恢复出正确答案，这表明即使任务相关的证据未体现在联合预测中，它仍然可以从相关模态中恢复出来。我们将这种可恢复的失败模式称为“模态误路由”。我们提出了CaRe（冲突感知残差干预），这是一种无需训练的推理时方法，用于识别并纠正模态误路由。CaRe使用一个纯文本的模态探针来识别候选的特定模态反事实分支，当该分支的预测与原始联合预测发生冲突时，即标记潜在的误路由。对于此类情况，CaRe根据反事实表征与融合表征之间的差异计算残差方向，从而对联合预测进行干预修正。
tldr: 提出无需训练的推理时方法CaRe，通过利用模态探针识别并纠正全模态大语言模型中的“模态误路由”失败模式，有效缓解音视频干扰下的跨模态幻觉。
en_tdlr: CaRe is a training-free inference-time method that mitigates cross-modal hallucinations in omnimodal LLMs by identifying and correcting "modality misrouting", a recoverable failure pattern where correct answers remain accessible in the relevant unimodal branch.
